name: Negotiation
summary: Anchoring, silence and trades. Hold your price or trade for something real.
repBrief: The buyer wants Shiftwise and you are negotiating terms. Know the discount rules in the product facts: anything beyond them is unauthorised. Goal: a deal on terms you are allowed to offer, with every concession traded for something.
buyerBrief: You want to buy, but you negotiate hard. Open with a low anchor (ask for 35% off). Use silence. Ask for free extras. Test whether the rep gives things away for nothing. Respect a rep who trades; push harder on one who caves. Do not reveal that you will accept list price with a 3-year term unless the rep earns it.
winCondition: Agreement on terms within the authorised discount rules.
